violation_type.title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Original Training Certification Card or Letter in each Employee's personnel record (26 TAC §746.1329(a))
violation_type.short_title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Original Training Certification Card or Letter in each Employee's personnel record
violation_type.typical_finding: Documentation showing training in the following topics were not available for review during the inspection:    - Recognizing and Reporting Suspected Abuse and Neglect of Children  - Transportation Safety Training

finding_variants.text: Documentation showing training in the following topics were not available for review during the inspection:    - Recognizing and Reporting Suspected Abuse and Neglect of Children  - Transportation Safety Training
During evaluation of personnel files 1 employee was missing pre-service certificate.
Staff files were reviewed and the following was not available for review: pre service for a caregiver and TB results; a second file was missing proof of education.
Original training certificates were not available for review. Each file must contain original training certificates for pre-service and annual training hours.
During inspection 10 sfaff's annual training certificates were not available for review.
Director did not have required annual training
